title: Give OLY-B-A3-02 a mechanism: learnings recorded, bundle attributed
summary: Add an integration test in athena-core that checks the firstmate rationale records carry rationale fields and that the README attributes the harness-engineering bundle under CC BY 4.0, then record it as OLY-B-A3-02's mechanism with a measure ending `status: not shown`. The audience is the spec reviewer who checks the requirement has a real mechanism.

defaults_applied.how: New test fails on mutated inputs and passes on the real files; fmt, clippy, test are criteria.
Mutation cases check the behavior, not only that the file exists.
The rule is enforced by a test and named in the spec.
The Hermes coverage gap is stated in the mechanism text.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Term Hermes: in this request it means Hermes Agent, the studied self-improving agent that writes its own skills (the first sense in docs/ontology.toml, term Hermes), not the Orchestration god of the Olympus pantheon.
Term firstmate: the first studied system, whose work handling is recorded in studies/firstmate-work-handling (docs/ontology.toml, BRIEF.md).

Code survey: crates/athena-core/tests/model_roster.rs is the pattern (spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism reads docs/spec.toml, checks the mechanism is not "none", owner is Athena, and the measure ends `status: not shown`); crates/athena-core/tests/buy_first.rs does the same with a stricter measure check; crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (~line 302) says a measure ends `status: <label>` or `status: not shown` and names the test. Entry point is the test file reading repo files via CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../..; no new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not touched. The property is measured directly on studies/firstmate-work-handling/rationales.json and README.md.

Existing code: studies/firstmate-work-handling/rationales.json (study.rationale/1 records with decision, alternatives, tradeoff, provenance, sources), README.md lines ~322-323 (Harness Engineering attribution, CC BY 4.0), docs/design/athena-v0.md §Attribution (~line 1606), docs/design/requirements-map.md row A3-2 (marks it Partial: firstmate work handling only). The new test reads these and reuses the model_roster.rs spec-entry check pattern.

The mechanism is a test, so the measure is `cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded; status: not shown`. The spec entry currently reads mechanism = "none" and measure = "The spec gap list; status: requirement".

Hermes Agent has no study records in studies/ yet, so the test covers what exists (firstmate rationale records, attribution) and the spec mechanism says Hermes study rationales are not yet covered. It does not create a Hermes study.

No refusal rule is added; Athena's gate and reading checks are unchanged. No config or governance file changes (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows). CHANGELOG.md gets the default entry. Environment: none, local files only.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-A3-02 no longer has mechanism = "none"; its mechanism names the new test file crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs and states the Hermes gap, the owner stays "Athena", and the measure ends with `status: not shown` and names the test command.

crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs exists and asserts that every record in studies/firstmate-work-handling/rationales.json has a non-empty decision, alternatives, tradeoff, provenance and at least one source.
The same test asserts README.md names the Harness Engineering bundle, its repository URL and the CC BY 4.0 license, and that docs/spec.toml's OLY-B-A3-02 entry is not mechanism = "none".

Mutation checks inside the test, run with `cargo test -p athena-core --test learnings_recorded`: a copy of the rationales text with one tradeoff emptied, and a copy of the README text without the license line, are each reported as a problem by the checking function, while the real files pass. This shows the test fails without the mechanism and passes with it.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass on the final tree (recorded Athena checks count under D115).
CHANGELOG.md records the change. The deliverables are limited to docs/spec.toml, the new test file under crates/athena-core/tests/, and CHANGELOG.md.

out_of_scope: Studying Hermes Agent or producing new study records
Changing the Athena gate, reading checks or any refusal rule
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
